A '''sweesonberry roll''' was a type of roll made with sweesonberries. They were sticky and sweet.<ref name="swg">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Sweesonberry roll}}</ref> [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] had a sweesonberry roll on [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]] during his mission to find [[Ferus Olin]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].
